Axolotl 0.1.1 comes with installers, which bring their own Java runtime, and with `axl setup`, so
the Gradle and Maven plugins no longer have to be built from source.

## Downloads

The installers bring their own Java runtime, put `axl` on the `PATH` and run `axl setup`, which
copies the Axolotl libraries and the Gradle and Maven plugins into the local Maven repository:

- `axolotl-0.1.1-windows-x64-setup.exe`: Windows. Not signed, so SmartScreen asks first: *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- `axolotl-0.1.1-macos-arm64.pkg`: macOS on Apple silicon. Not signed: see the [installation guide](https://github.com/succubus-uwu/axolotl/blob/v0.1.1/docs/install.md) for how to open it.
- `axolotl-0.1.1-linux-amd64.deb`: Debian 12 and Ubuntu 22.04 or newer: `sudo apt install ./axolotl-0.1.1-linux-amd64.deb`.
- `axolotl-0.1.1-linux-x64.tar.gz`: other Linux systems. Unpack it and run `install.sh`, which needs no root.

Guides to installing and using the `axl` command line, in English and Russian:
`axolotl-0.1.1-windows-en.pdf`, `axolotl-0.1.1-macos-en.pdf`, `axolotl-0.1.1-linux-en.pdf` and the
`-ru` versions.

Without an installer:

- `axl-0.1.1.zip`: the command line compiler for Java 21. Unzip it, put `bin` on your `PATH` and run
  `axl setup` for the Gradle and Maven plugins.
- `axolotl-0.1.1.vsix`: the VS Code extension: `code --install-extension axolotl-0.1.1.vsix`.
- `axl-intellij-0.1.1.zip`: the IntelliJ IDEA plugin: *Settings | Plugins | Install Plugin from Disk*.

The Gradle and Maven plugins are not published to a public repository yet: `axl setup` installs them
into the local Maven repository, and projects find them there with `mavenLocal()`.

## What is new

- The installers and `axl setup`. The bundled runtime has every module of Java SE, so code that uses
  `java.awt` or `java.beans` compiles and runs.
- `--help` on every command, and `axl help`.
- `axlLspConfig` and `axl:lsp-config` write a module for each source set, and a Gradle module sees
  the sources of the projects it depends on. The format of `axl.json` changed with it; run the task
  again after upgrading.
- Fixes for Windows paths, non-UTF-8 locales and the build.
- Compiler fixes from seven rounds of review: a `when` over an `Int?` no longer unboxes null, `==`
  compares numbers from `?:` and `try` by value, initialization order and same-file `private` are
  checked, raw generic values from Java are rejected, and long `?:` chains and nested `if` values
  compile in linear time.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/succubus-uwu/axolotl/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

## Known limitations

- `var x = when` with lambdas in its branches needs a written type.
- Error Prone in Maven needs `.mvn/jvm.config`, and Gradle compiles in a forked JVM.
